scope: DISPLAY ONLY: existing offline text and original written-task screenshots, zh/en, desktop/mobile.

resultBinding.role: Existing screenshot/HTML bindings and recorded geometry; not a substitute for this batch's visual observations.

evidenceBoundary.limitation: These are supplied isolated headless offline renders, not the running application. No headed browser, real app route, authentication, navigation interaction, or app media-width behavior was tested. Operations requires authoritative headed product evidence for formal UI acceptance; this display-only pass does not supply it.

imageAccounting.returnPolicy: Textual paths and counts only; no image payload or image-bearing history forwarded to another chat.

decisionPolicy.pass: No genuine display defect observed on the inspected pixels; fine-detail limits remain explicitly bounded.
decisionPolicy.revise: An observable rendering, clipping, overlap, locale, safety-wording visibility, or missing-task defect.
decisionPolicy.blocked: An unavailable or mismatched required screenshot preventing the specified inspection.
decisionPolicy.tinyDetailPolicy: Tall full-page screenshots were inspected once without cropping or reopening. The viewer reduced three images. Exact tiny subscripts, superscripts, averaging-bar spans, radical extents, source glyph identity, and graph-coordinate semantics are not newly validated by this review; they remain existing semantic evidence and separate inherited HOLDs. Viewer reduction alone is not a new HOLD or a product display defect.

inheritedEvidence.separateGraphMathAndSourceGlyphHolds: Remain unchanged and outside this display-only decision.
